{{Quote|This is Master Mobari. She led an attack against Ithorian terrorists but she was betrayed by her Padawan. He died in the same explosion that took her sight.|A'Sharad Hett on the injured Master Mobari|<ref name="Republic 58">[[Republic 58|''Republic'' 58]]</ref>}}
'''Evan-Ott''' was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who was apprenticed to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Sora Mobari]]<ref name="CSWE Evan" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Death Date" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the pair were dispatched<ref name="CSWE Mobari">{{CSWECite|II|321|Mobari, Sora}}</ref> to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] to lead an [[Attack against Ithorian terrorists|attack]] against [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]. However, Evan-Ott tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his Master with an explosion, only to end up being killed in the blast himself.<ref name="CSWE Mobari" /> Mobari initially survived the blast with significant damage to her [[eye]]s and was transferred to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] on the world [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]]. There, Mobari succumbed to her injuries shortly after [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] shared the details of Evan-Ott's betrayal to fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Republic 58" />

==Behind the scenes==
Evan-Ott was first mentioned, albeit unnamed, in the [[Republic 58|fifty–eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[W. Haden Blackman]]<ref name="Republic 58" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 17]], [[2003]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-204/Star-Wars-Republic-58The-Battle-of-Jabiim-Part-4-of-4|text=Star Wars: Republic #58 The Battle of Jabiim (Part 4 of 4)}}</ref> The character was later identified as Evan-Ott in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE Evan" />
